hypotheses.root_cause: Firmware crashed on an unhandled CPU exception (fault handler): Task stack overflow corrupts the return frame
hypotheses.rationale: Null-pointer guard and service retries precede an unhandled HardFault/BusFault with a stack trace, indicating a firmware logic defect (race or bad deref) rather than a hardware fault. Evidence contains the tell-tale(s) 'stack watermark exceeded', 'used_pct' for RC_FW_STACK_OVERFLOW.
recommended_actions: Increase the task stack or reduce frame size in the hot path
Enable stack-canary checks in the debug build
Symbolicate the captured backtrace and inspect the faulting frame
Audit the retried service path for races / null dereferences

hypotheses.root_cause: Junction temperature exceeded the thermal trip threshold: A sustained power burst outruns the cooling headroom
hypotheses.rationale: Temperature climbed past the DVFS policy and crossed the 105C trip point before throttling could recover it, triggering an emergency shutdown — a cooling-solution or fan-profile shortfall under sustained workload. Evidence contains the tell-tale(s) 'power burst detected', 'p_w=' for RC_WORKLOAD_BURST. 1 of 3 similar historical incidents (runs 000015) were resolved as RC_WORKLOAD_BURST.
recommended_actions: Cap the burst power or lengthen the DVFS step-down reaction
Add thermal headroom to the test's power envelope
Inspect heatsink mounting/TIM and airflow on the DUT
Make the fan/DVFS profile more aggressive ahead of the trip point
